nodes.label: The cycle — X(n+1) = R(Xn u Dn)
nodes.rationale: The whole work is one recursion, halting when the increment is already implied; it has never halted, and that non-halting is treated as evidence rather than failure.

nodes.label: The closure-to-seed ratio as the cycle's falsifier
nodes.rationale: Closure 265 against seed 17, a ratio of 15.6:1. The seed has not moved across any cycle; a genuinely new object that nothing derives would move it, so the ratio is the project's own falsification test.

nodes.label: The languages, and why each is necessary
nodes.rationale: A language is a coordinate system, translation is re-coordinatisation, and E is the cost. Necessity is not availability: each language must state a quantity the others cannot, and the table is that check run.

nodes.label: The chains — the longest derivation paths
Verification coverage, stated rather than implied
nodes.rationale: 103 assertions name 46 of 299 objects and no verifier touches the other 167; of the check fields 85 state a finding, 91 repeat the object's key, 19 name a function and 18 are empty — so a check field present is not a verification performed.

nodes.label: E — the closure defect
nodes.rationale: Naming the gap between a set and its closure as a defect is the book's step; the quantity itself is Moore's closure minus the set.

nodes.label: ent — the entrant operator
nodes.rationale: Chained from cfg(Z-1), it reproduces 107 of 107 measured ground configurations with c = 137.035999 the only entered number; the margin against the runner-up is its own error bar.

nodes.label: N8 — the norm of a sum of three square roots
E_W — the metric defect
nodes.rationale: For Lambda E_W is empty because a cell carries no number, which is why the book needed only E; for Lambda_spectra the two differ and the gap is the cells placed but unvalued.

nodes.label: The step operator
nodes.rationale: It must be derived from measured cells only: re-deriving from the walked result tightens the step spuriously, because the walked values were generated by that step.

nodes.label: Binary — the box, one bit per cell
Statistics — recovery from pairwise marginals
nodes.rationale: It recovers Lambda exactly from its marginals and that is the whole of what it can do: on the periodic table it reports E = 0 where R reports 36, because marginals cannot see a hole. Necessary for one purpose and useless for another, and knowing which is the point of having it.

nodes.label: Documentary — has anyone said this before
nodes.rationale: It has no closure operator at all; the precedent question can be bounded by search and never settled, which is why two searches returning nothing is evidence of a kind the other languages never have to produce.

nodes.label: The void — 46.4% of a typical interval
Family A — the operators, closure, envelope, orientation (43 objects)
Family S — the seed, generation, covering, structure (21 objects)
Family L — Lambda's own constraints (68 objects)
Family T — the tower and its couplings (16 objects)
Family K — transit and information (25 objects)

Family LS — the Löwdin solution (8 objects)
Family 3B — three bodies, the index of families (9 objects)
Family EM — the electromagnetic quotient (10 objects)
Family P — the spectral mechanisms (17 objects)
The box seed law, d + c − 2
The seed as binary, corrected
nodes.rationale: The complement pairings once printed here were a property of a biased 219-cover sample and are refuted at Lambda-8 itself; what survives as law is the both-symbols-per-column reading, and only that.

nodes.label: Seaton's term — the polarisation term
nodes.rationale: Supplying alpha as a species label rather than a universal constant cuts the l>=4 rms by 36%; below l = 4 it must be gated off, since K(l) is small there and the fit is driven to rms 39.3.

nodes.label: The validated domain
nodes.rationale: Validated in the verified-plus-possible region and extrapolated outside it: the 277 in-region channels fit better than the 311-channel fit on fewer points, because nine-tenths of the Ne-dependence was open-shell contamination.

nodes.label: The channel equation, final form
nodes.rationale: Four fitted numbers with every input from the ground state or the periodic table; it values all 1,648 cells R places, where the walk valued none.

nodes.label: The bridge equation
nodes.rationale: An additive fit preserves values and not rank, a purely multiplicative one preserves rank and cannot represent an exception; the regime factor is what lets one form do both, which is a Pareto statement about two objectives.

nodes.label: The deficit term — the penetration deficit
The exchange factor (withdrawn)
nodes.rationale: Withdrawn at register 1168 because the fitted sign is opposite to the measured one; kept as ASSERTED rather than removed because the term is real and the form is wrong. A uniform s can only give 0 of 66 or 66 of 66 triplet-above-singlet pairs, and the measurement is neither.

nodes.label: Half-sided modular inclusion on a non-expanding horizon
nodes.rationale: The horizon's definition supplies a state condition at background order and leaves a gap at perturbation order; Sorce 2024 closes the geometric route by construction, so only the algebraic route remains.

nodes.label: The defect closed: chord = rot + perp
The corridor — a system of linear inequalities
nodes.rationale: The coefficients are node counts, so the endpoints lie in Q(sqrt N) and take only nineteen distinct values across the table; all 106 intervals are non-empty, so the system is consistent.

nodes.label: The staircase algebra of a closed index
Lambda_spectra's closure and its limit (E = 11)
nodes.rationale: The index runs to the last available species and stops; 38 of the 58 defects need more electrons than any atom has and are past the limit, not defects. The remaining eleven are the Madelung exceptions, recovered as closure defects rather than looked up.

nodes.label: Rival = donor iff the donor is not full
nodes.rationale: A subshell at capacity is not Pauli-admissible and cannot be anyone's rival; Pd is its own control, the only partial s donor, and it sits with the d and f donors rather than with Cr.

nodes.label: Lambda_law — seven laws on (law, carrier), E = 0
The refusal — `standing` cannot be a coordinate
nodes.rationale: An index whose coordinates mix the object with the observer cannot close, because the observer's axis has no order the object respects; the same fault appears as origin in Lambda_var, kind in Lambda_phys and state in Lambda_ladder.

nodes.label: Shape space and the shape sphere
The algebraic variety of the three-body potential
Deville, Barette & Van Hentenryck 1999 — staircase constraint class
Baker & Pixley 1975 — binary determination, majority term
